refusal.message: the detected board is an esp32s3 (ESP32-S3 (QFN56) (revision v0.2)), but project laser-trigger is set to esp32s2: nothing is flashed
refusal.hint: connect the esp32s2 board and detect again, or set the project chip to esp32s3 (set_board)
